doc: Host C/C++ roots built outside recipe.py (their build scripts name the compile line). Each is preprocessed with the host gcc (`gcc -M`, cwd = root cwd); every system header it reads must belong to a package of env.json (packages + dependency closure): envcheck check (a read of a header owned by no pinned package, or a header that is missing, is a mismatch) and envcheck snapshot (the packages that own the reads are pinned). Replaced by the PP read set of the recipe stage when a root enters recipe.py.
